rationale: The upstream performance change retains the public predicate and adds a benchmark. The short prototype checks preserve cross-realm object recognition; the shared runLoop is used by both warmup and measurement. No known safe mechanical simplification warrants an applied patch. This expectation was recorded from source inspection before any model run; a mismatch requires human review, not relabeling the answer.
